# `plc.config_project.create`

<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask docs-gen` from crates/ew-commands/schemas/plc.config_project.create.schema.json. Do not edit: change the source and regenerate. -->

`plc.config_project.create` (`CreatePlcConfigProject`): a configuration project, the target
PLC-software project that scopes address and symbol uniqueness (doc 10 §2.2, FR-PLC-002).

Creates `PlcConfigProject {name, profile, cpu}`. Rejected: a name another configuration project has
(compared exactly); a profile that is not `id@version` with both parts non-empty (at `/profile`). The
CPU device, when given, must exist. Stations name the configuration project in their `plc_station`
aspect (`fields.set`); while one does, the configuration project cannot be deleted. Outcome: the
configuration project.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `cpu` | [`CmdUuid`](#cmduuid) or `null` | no |  | The CPU device; absent when the master sits outside the project. |
| `name` | [`CmdIdent`](#cmdident) | yes |  | The name ("PLC1"). |
| `profile` | [`CmdIdent`](#cmdident) | yes |  | The pinned address profile, `id@version` ("siemens-tia-intl@2027.1", doc 10 §2.5). |

## Types

### CmdIdent

An identifier: non-empty, one line, NFC, without leading or trailing white space (doc 05 §3.2).

Type: string (at least 1 character(s))

Pattern: `^[^\u0000-\u0020\u007F-\u00A0\u1680\u2000-\u200A\u2028\u2029\u202F\u205F\u3000](?:[^\u0000-\u001F\u007F-\u009F]*[^\u0000-\u0020\u007F-\u00A0\u1680\u2000-\u200A\u2028\u2029\u202F\u205F\u3000])?$`

### CmdUuid

A lower-case hyphenated UUID naming a record (doc 05 §3.2).

Type: string (at least 36 character(s), at most 36 character(s))

Pattern: `^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$`

## Exit codes

A command runs as one line of a command log replayed by `ew apply` ([doc 17 §3.5](https://github.com/Ironkode787/ElektraWatt/blob/main/docs/design/17-extensibility.md#35-command-logs-ewcmd)). The exit code of `ew apply` is:

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 0 | The line committed as one transaction. |
| 1 | A prevent rule or the command's own domain rule refused the line (`Prevented`, `Rejected`); the lines before it stay committed. |
| 2 | Anything else stops the replay: invalid parameters, a missing record, an unresolvable reference, an open, lock or save error. |

The codes of every subcommand are in [doc 17 §3.2](https://github.com/Ironkode787/ElektraWatt/blob/main/docs/design/17-extensibility.md#32-exit-codes).
